import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def makegrid(h,w,pts):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in pts: g[r][c]=2
    return g

def colored(g, color):
    return {(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color}
d1=makegrid(19,13,[(3,8),(6,4),(6,12),(9,10),(11,7)])
e1_3={(4,8),(5,8)}|{(6,c) for c in range(5,12)}|{(r,c) for c in (7,10) for r in (7,8)}|{(9,7),(10,7)}
d2=makegrid(16,12,[(2,5),(6,2),(7,10),(10,8),(12,5)])
e2_3={(r,5) for r in range(3,12)}|{(6,3),(6,4)}|{(7,c) for c in range(6,10)}|{(10,6),(10,7)}
print('demo1:', colored(mod.transform(d1),3)==e1_3, colored(mod.transform(d1),3)^e1_3)
print('demo2:', colored(mod.transform(d2),3)==e2_3, colored(mod.transform(d2),3)^e2_3)
test=makegrid(14,17,[(3,6),(6,4),(8,1),(8,12),(10,10),(12,8)])
answer=mod.transform(test)
print('answer grid:')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in answer))
